lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: What are you doing? Are you busy?
Super busy.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Can you help me out?
I said I was busy.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Come on, don't be like that.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Whenever you're busy, it's a good idea to take breaks.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: And this is reaaaalllyy important.
What is it?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I've hatched a plan to make Mica happy,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: and I need your help.
How come you're always pestering Mica?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It's not pestering!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Everything I do to Mica

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: comes from a place of affection.
Fine, what exactly is this plan of yours?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Oooh, so you're going to help me?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: First off, we've gotta scare the pants off of her.
So your usual M.O.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Not at all!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Usually I'm just joking,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: but this time I'm serious.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm placing you in charge of giving her a big scare.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: The only question is: what should we do to her?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Scold her for some nonsensical reason, or...
I'm already not into this.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Then, when she starts crying,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'll make my grand entrance,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: and reveal that it was all a prank.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Then Mica will be super happy and relieved.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: What do you think?
I don't think anyone will come out of this feeling happy.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: But I'm having fun just talking about it.
Come back when you have a better plan.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Fine, I guess I have no choice.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'll just surprise her as usual and tell her it was a prank.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Thanks for your time anyways, Old-Timer.
